description: How many contacts a campaign would reach, and whether the reputation gate would allow it. It is the only way to see the size of a campaign without starting it. For an A/B test it also reports the sample size and per-variant count against the 100-per-variant floor; a send below the floor is refused.

id.description: The campaign's id from create_broadcast or list_broadcasts (a UUID), not its name

name: preview_broadcast
